# Dear ImGui

Version: **v1.93.0** (official release, unmodified source files)

Source: https://github.com/ocornut/imgui/tree/v1.93.0

License: MIT; see [LICENSE.txt](LICENSE.txt).

This directory contains the core, demo, and Win32 / DirectX 12 backend files
needed by PathTracingSample. They are compiled directly by the Visual Studio
project. No additional package restore or generator is required for Dear ImGui.

Keep upstream formatting and naming intact in these third-party source files.
When updating, replace all upstream files together from the same release tag.
